title: Carrera GT in the Night Studio Before Dawn
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
description:
Inside the quiet shadows of the Night Studio, a pearl white Porsche Carrera GT rests beside the glass, catching the first pale blue light of dawn with a long night of work finally behind you. You are wrapped in two hours of music only, shaped by warm synth pads, a soft deep bass, and a gentle ambient beat drifting through the room. It is a calm, grounding space made for you to keep working, settle into studying, or simply unwind and relax.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
